task.description: Design and add tests for SCH-07 recurring timers. Create/update tests/specs/SCH-07.md and implement backend tests that verify: same-transaction fire+re-arm behavior, finite repeat completion (R3), infinite repeat continuation (R/PT...), and interoperability with cancellation/missed-firing semantics. Ensure deterministic tests and no reliance on wall clock randomness.
acceptance_criteria: Every SCH-07 MUST/SHOULD acceptance criterion has at least one test case
Test spec file exists before or alongside test source
No SkipZigTest placeholders for SCH-07 critical paths

result.summary: Added SCH-07 recurring timer test spec and deterministic backend integration coverage for critical recurring paths: same-transaction fire+re-arm behavior, finite repeat completion (R3), infinite repeat continuation (R/PT...), cancellation interoperability, and missed-firing startup behavior with fired_late metadata.
